convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev) with 8 buffer parameters, and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing and order management logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal gating
min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup

long.left: Buffer 3 (buy signal dots) or Buffer 5 (buy signal dots alternate)

short.left: Buffer 2 (sell signal dots) or Buffer 4 (sell signal dots alternate)

other_exits: Signal-based close via BuyPosClose/SellPosClose modes: DIRECT mode closes long when VWMA rises (Line[0]>Line[1]) and closes short when VWMA falls (Line[0]<Line[1]); POINT mode closes long on sell signal dots and closes short on buy signal dots

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots (MM=0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. Logic implemented in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Three signal modes per direction (open/close): POINT uses indicator dot buffers (buffers 2-5, where !=EMPTY_VALUE means signal present); DIRECT uses VWMA line slope comparison across 2-3 consecutive bars; WITHOUT disables that signal. Entry and exit signals are independently configurable. Signal evaluation uses SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) by default. When SignalBar=0, intrabar evaluation is allowed without new-bar guard. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on CopyBuffer failure. BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen use UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime as trade time gating. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests position tracking via global variables.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer the Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev custom indicator to replicate its 6 buffers in Python: buffer 0=VWMA line, buffer 2=sell signal dots, buffer 3=buy signal dots, buffer 4=alternate sell dots, buffer 5=alternate buy dots, buffer 1 likely=std dev band. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all 5 MarginMode sizing variants and the BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/Close functions with signal time gating, global variable tracking, and position existence checks — these must all be reimplemented. The SignalMode enum (POINT/DIRECT/WITHOUT) creates 3x3x3x3=81 possible signal configuration combinations that must be handled. Signal evaluation at bar index SignalBar (default 1) means always using the last completed bar.
